verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents several AI features that generate insights/suggestions from workspace data: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence to flag issues before audit (docs-11, docs-23, docs-43), GenAI DDQ autofill drafts questionnaire responses (docs-44, docs-61), and an MCP-connected assistant can query audit/evidence status (docs-28, docs-29). However, the AI Helpbot is scoped mainly to answering from support docs rather than the user's own compliance data (docs-45, docs-62), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of quality or accuracy of these AI outputs. Missing for 10: independent validation of AI-generated insight quality, and broader examples of proactive AI suggestions beyond evidence QA/DDQ autofill.
